projectTitle: Vases: Test Tube Babies, a series of bud vases
project_haiku: Test Tube Babies is a series of bud vases. A glass tube holds the flower. Hardwood, aluminum, Corian, and colored plastic hold the tube. They are small objects, built as both vases and sculptures.
project_footer_CTA: Interested in objects that are useful and still made one at a time? These vases are that work.
pageSummary:
The job

The series needed a flower holder that was also a study of materials. The flower's job is done by a test tube. Everything else is the composition around it.

What we built

Each vase combines hardwood, aluminum sheet, Corian, colored plastic, or plexiglass, joined so the tube sits plumb and the object stands. Warm materials sit next to cool ones on purpose. They are made with ordinary shop tools, which is what the technology line records.

Outcomes

The vases hold flowers. They also hold up as small sculptures. The series is a material study that happens to be useful.
